title: Sardis, mid-6th century BCE — the struck electrum cylinder (A2-S04, A2-S05)

scale.note: An early electrum stater is about 20 mm across; at 25 studs per metre that is 2 studs, which is why the coin is 2x2 and not larger.

_substitution: Round 2x2 bricks and a round tile in the screenplay; square parts here, for the same reason as tokens.json. Colour 82 is real Metallic_Gold #DBAC34 against the palette's Elektrum #D4AF37 -- eight steps away, and metallic, which is what the shot is about.
